mainEntity.name: Is interior log sealing different from regular caulking or exterior chinking?

acceptedAnswer.text: Interior sealing is not the same as exterior chinking or general air sealing in a standard house. Log homes need materials that stay flexible and work with the natural movement of logs, so a log-home specialist is usually the better choice.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes. Log homes need flexible products and methods that handle wood movement, so regular caulking is not always the right answer. Interior sealing and exterior chinking solve related but different problems.
